```{r setup, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressMessages(library(ggplot2))
P  <- "/project/xinhe/xsun/GLI-Hedgehog_Signaling"
r  <- read.delim(file.path(P, "results/1.geneset_enrichment/enrichment_fisher.tsv"), check.names = FALSE)
gs <- read.delim(file.path(P, "data/gene_sets/enrichment_gene_sets.tsv"), check.names = FALSE)
bg <- read.delim(file.path(P, "data/gene_sets/background_protein_coding_hgnc.tsv"))

# the two gene sets used on this page
sets <- c(ASD = "SFARI_cat1", NDD = "NDD_wang2022")
lab  <- c(ASD = "ASD (SFARI category 1)", NDD = "NDD (Wang et al. 2022)")
d <- r[r$cluster != "all" & r$gene_set %in% sets, ]
d$set <- names(sets)[match(d$gene_set, sets)]
d$k <- as.integer(d$cluster)
d <- d[order(d$set, d$k), ]

f2  <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f", x)
pv  <- function(p) ifelse(p >= 0.001, sprintf("%.3f", p), formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
get1 <- function(s, k, v) d[d$set == s & d$k == k, v]
n_set <- function(s) sum(gs$gene_set == sets[[s]])
shared <- length(intersect(gs$hgnc_id[gs$gene_set == sets[["ASD"]]], gs$hgnc_id[gs$gene_set == sets[["NDD"]]]))
sig <- d[d$p_value < 0.05, ]

# chart ink and colours (two categorical series: blue = ASD, orange = NDD)
INK <- "#0b0b0b"; INK2 <- "#52514e"; MUTED <- "#898781"; GRID <- "#e1e0d9"; AXIS <- "#c3c2b7"
SURF <- "#fcfcfb"; COL <- c(ASD = "#2a78d6", NDD = "#eb6834")
```

# Summary

```{r summary_text}
both  <- intersect(sig$k[sig$set == "ASD"], sig$k[sig$set == "NDD"])
fold_rng <- range(d$fold[d$k %in% both])
asd_only <- setdiff(sig$k[sig$set == "ASD"], sig$k[sig$set == "NDD"])
ndd_only <- setdiff(sig$k[sig$set == "NDD"], sig$k[sig$set == "ASD"])
```

* **Clusters `r paste(both, collapse = " and ")`** are enriched for both ASD and
  NDD genes, `r f2(fold_rng[1])`&ndash;`r f2(fold_rng[2])` times more than expected by chance:
  `r paste0("cluster ", both, ": ASD ", f2(sapply(both, function(k) get1("ASD", k, "fold"))), "x (p = ",
            pv(sapply(both, function(k) get1("ASD", k, "p_value"))), "), NDD ",
            f2(sapply(both, function(k) get1("NDD", k, "fold"))), "x (p = ",
            pv(sapply(both, function(k) get1("NDD", k, "p_value"))), ")", collapse = "; ")`.
`r if (length(asd_only)) paste0("* **Cluster ", paste(asd_only, collapse = ", "), "** is enriched for ASD genes only, more weakly (",
   paste0(f2(sapply(asd_only, function(k) get1("ASD", k, "fold"))), "x, p = ",
          pv(sapply(asd_only, function(k) get1("ASD", k, "p_value"))), collapse = "; "), ").") else ""`
`r if (length(ndd_only)) paste0("* **Cluster ", paste(ndd_only, collapse = ", "), "** is enriched for NDD genes only.") else ""`
* No other cluster reaches p < 0.05 for either gene set.

# Gene sets and test

| Gene set | Source | Genes |
|---|---|---|
| **ASD** | [SFARI Gene](https://gene.sfari.org/) category 1 (high-confidence autism genes), release 07-12-2026 | `r n_set("ASD")` |
| **NDD** | [Wang et al. 2022, *PNAS*](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.2203491119): genes with an excess of damaging de novo variants in 46,612 autism and developmental-delay trios | `r n_set("NDD")` |

Counts are protein-coding genes after updating names to current HGNC symbols.
The two sets share `r shared` genes.

**Test.** For each cluster and gene set, a two-sided Fisher's exact test
compares the cluster with the rest of the genome (all `r fmt(nrow(bg))`
protein-coding genes). p-values are not corrected for the `r nrow(d)` tests
(about `r round(0.05 * nrow(d), 1)` would reach p < 0.05 by chance).

# Results

```{r lollipop, fig.width=7.6, fig.height=5.4}
p <- d
p$y  <- (11 - p$k) + ifelse(p$set == "ASD", 0.18, -0.18)    # cluster 1 on top; ASD above NDD
p$fc <- pmin(pmax(p$fold, 0.2), 5)
p$fill <- ifelse(p$p_value < 0.05, p$set, "none")
p$plab <- ifelse(p$p_value < 0.05, paste0("p = ", pv(p$p_value)), "")
ggplot(p, aes(y = y, colour = set)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, colour = AXIS, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = fc, yend = y), linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(x = fc, fill = fill), shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = fc * 1.12, label = plab), hjust = 0, size = 3, colour = INK2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL, labels = lab, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(COL, none = SURF), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log2", limits = c(0.2, 8), breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4),
                     labels = c("0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:10, labels = 10:1, expand = expansion(add = 0.5)) +
  labs(x = "Fold enrichment (observed / expected, log scale)", y = "Cluster",
       caption = "Filled: p < 0.05 (two-sided Fisher's exact test). Hollow: p >= 0.05. 1 = as expected by chance.") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.3),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = SURF, colour = NA),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = INK2), axis.title = element_text(colour = INK2),
        legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left", legend.text = element_text(colour = INK, size = 10),
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = MUTED, hjust = 0))
```

```{r table}
w <- function(s) d[d$set == s, ]
a <- w("ASD"); n <- w("NDD")
bold <- function(x, p) ifelse(p < 0.05, paste0("**", x, "**"), x)
tab <- data.frame(
  cluster = a$k, genes = fmt(a$n_cluster),
  a_obs = paste0(a$overlap, " / ", f2(a$expected)), a_fold = bold(sprintf("%.2f", a$fold), a$p_value),
  a_p = bold(pv(a$p_value), a$p_value),
  n_obs = paste0(n$overlap, " / ", f2(n$expected)), n_fold = bold(sprintf("%.2f", n$fold), n$p_value),
  n_p = bold(pv(n$p_value), n$p_value))
knitr::kable(tab, format = "pipe", align = "rrrrrrrr",
             col.names = c("Cluster", "Genes", "ASD: observed / expected", "ASD: fold", "ASD: p",
                           "NDD: observed / expected", "NDD: fold", "NDD: p"),
             caption = "Bold: p < 0.05.")
```

## Genes behind the significant results

```{r genes}
g <- sig[order(sig$k, sig$set), ]
knitr::kable(data.frame(g$k, lab[g$set], g$overlap, gsub(",", ", ", g$overlap_genes)),
             col.names = c("Cluster", "Gene set", "Genes", "Overlapping genes"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Detailed results for all 7 gene sets (SFARI categories 1 and 2, TADA tiers, NDD)
are on the [detailed page](geneset_enrichment.html).
